create_BayesianGaussianMixture_fit: create a BayesianGaussianMixture model and fit it to clustered data with inferred components
fit_BayesianGaussianMixture_predict: fit a BayesianGaussianMixture model and predict cluster assignments for new samples
fit_BayesianGaussianMixture_score_sample: fit a BayesianGaussianMixture model and score the likelihood of new samples under each component
use_BayesianGaussianMixture_dirichlet_pr: use BayesianGaussianMixture with dirichlet_process prior to automatically determine the number of active components
configure_BayesianGaussianMixture_covari: configure BayesianGaussianMixture with different covariance types such as full, tied, diag, or spherical
